therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell proliferation suppression via EGFR pathway blockade
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: first-line EGFR-mutated (exon 19 deletion or L858R) advanced non-small cell lung cancer patients

results.effect_size: HR 0.62 (95% CI: 0.49–0.79); median PFS 25.5 months (combo) vs 16.7 months (osimertinib alone)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Osimertinib plasma concentrations (Cmin,ss ~392–397 nmol/L; AUCss ~11790–11840 h*nmol/L) were similar with or without chemotherapy, confirming no PK interaction
biomarker_changes: Osimertinib steady-state plasma concentrations were similar between combination and monotherapy arms (Cmin,ss 392.5 vs 397.2 nmol/L; Cmax,ss 587.5 vs 593.4 nmol/L; AUCss 11840 vs 11790 h*nmol/L)
AZ5104 metabolite concentrations were also similar between arms
EGFR exon 19 deletion: PFS HR 0.60 (95% CI: 0.44–0.83) favoring combination
EGFR L858R: PFS HR 0.63 (95% CI: 0.44–0.90) favoring combination
Depth of response: -50.77% (combo) vs -47.41% (monotherapy); difference -3.36%, p=0.1067
PFS2 HR 0.70 (95% CI: 0.52–0.93), p=0.0132 favoring combination

QoL: osimertinib monotherapy showed better physical functioning (+6.74 vs +2.37), less fatigue (-6.31 vs -0.03), less appetite loss (-4.58 vs +2.87), and better global health status (+7.38 vs +3.32) vs combination
subgroup_findings: EGFR exon 19 deletion subgroup: PFS HR 0.60 (95% CI: 0.44–0.83) favoring combination
EGFR L858R subgroup: PFS HR 0.63 (95% CI: 0.44–0.90) favoring combination
Median TTD for fatigue: 5.9 months (combo) vs 20.0 months (monotherapy), favoring monotherapy
Median TTD for alopecia: 3.4 months (combo) vs 8.9 months (monotherapy), favoring monotherapy
Median TTD for dyspnea subscale: 9.0 months (combo) vs 19.4 months (monotherapy), favoring monotherapy
safety_signals: Combination arm associated with worse QoL scores for physical functioning, fatigue, and appetite loss vs monotherapy
Median TTD for alopecia markedly shorter in combination arm (3.4 vs 8.9 months)
Median TTD for fatigue shorter in combination arm (5.9 vs 20.0 months)
Median TTD for peripheral neuropathy shorter in combination arm (11.3 vs 15.1 months)
Retinal tear reported in safety run-in cisplatin+pemetrexed arm (1/15)
Grade 3–5 AEs reported in safety run-in arms

dose_info.dose: Osimertinib 80 mg; Pemetrexed 500 mg/m²; Carboplatin AUC5 or Cisplatin 75 mg/m²
dose_info.schedule: Osimertinib once daily; Pemetrexed/platinum on Day 1 of 21-day cycles for 4 cycles, then pemetrexed maintenance every 3 weeks

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Pemetrexed-induced DNA damage and antimetabolite cytotoxicity augments the anti-proliferative biology of osimertinib's EGFR blockade, resulting in deeper and more durable tumor suppression
modulation_entries.citation: Hazard Ratio (HR) = 0.62 (95% CI: 0.49–0.79), p = <0.0001; median PFS 25.5 months (AZD9291 + Chemo) vs 16.7 months (AZD9291)

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Carboplatin-mediated DNA cross-linking adds cytotoxic burden that amplifies the tumor-suppressive biology of osimertinib's EGFR kinase inhibition
modulation_entries.citation: Hazard Ratio (HR) = 0.62 (95% CI: 0.49–0.79), p = <0.0001; median PFS 25.5 months (AZD9291 + Chemo) vs 16.7 months (AZD9291)
